{"reason": "6 of 8 false-positive rows (confidence=0.44, 0.6, 0.66, 0.61, 0.67, 0.67) show v1 arbitrates weakly-supported changes, driving false-arbitration-rate to 0.714. Adding the high-confidence? gate should cut false arbitrations while preserving recall >= 0.8, raising fitness above 0.286.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
